White Holland jake (a young tom)

Knack: Quick Feet. +1 white die when you Scram, and a Scram that works can take you two zones.

Quirk: Show-off. Whenever you roll a Great, you strike a pose: a “Huh?” token goes on your spot.

Knack: Mother Hen. When you Hunker Down, every other turkey in your zone lowers its urge by 1 too.

Hazel

Chocolate hen

draw Hazel here

Knack: Keen Eye. At the start of the turkeys’ turn, the Storyteller rolls the farmer’s route die and tells the flock where he’ll walk if no “Huh?” token calls him. Close Calls don’t raise the urge of turkeys in your zone.

Quirk: Scaredy. A Close Call happens to you when the farmer or the dog ends in your zone or next to it.
